blocks.x: Alan King, Burgaard Adams were with the Nighthawks.
Mm-hmm. Now, Burgaard Adams was an alto player, you said. Burgaard Adams played alto.

And Rufus O'Levy played tenor sax. He lives in California now, in San Francisco. And Alton King, he's also deceased. He was a school teacher. He was a teacher in Franklin, Louisiana then. Mm-hmm. He played alto.
And Robert Stafford was a drummer.
He was the business manager. Mm-hmm. And Burgaard Adams was the musical director.
